mechanism: gonadotropin releasing factor hormone receptor agonist

hypothesis.mechanism: gonadotropin releasing factor hormone receptor agonist
context_requirements: Expression of GNRHR or LHCGR on the target cell
An intact Gq/11-phospholipase C signaling axis
A cell type in which GnRH receptor activation couples to transcriptional programs; most non-reproductive cell lines lack this
falsifiers: Reproducible induction of immediate-early or hormone-responsive landmark genes at 6 h in any of the nine lines
Dose-dependent transcriptional changes at 10 micromolar that are absent in GNRHR/LHCGR-negative lines but present in receptor-positive lines
Consistent changes in proliferation or stress programs at 24 h across multiple lines
